name: idea-vault
description: Summarize ideas and discussions, keep one freeform memo per idea folder, and save or resume content through an existing GitHub connection only on explicit user request.

interface.shortDescription: アイデア・議論・自由なメモをGitHubに保存
interface.longDescription: Maintain idea.md, discussions.md, and one freeform memo.md in each idea folder. Preserve memo text without automatic formatting or summarization. On explicit request, save, update, search, and resume content using the user's existing GitHub connection. No additional MCP server is required.
